caption: Read depth along the genome for simulated single-strand reads of length 100. Bars: mean over 200 simulated runs (whiskers: interquartile range across runs). Black line: exact distribution for this simulator (finite genome, reads fully inside it). Dashed red: Lander-Waterman Poisson approximation, which ignores the genome ends. Largest absolute gap between simulation and the exact model in any bin: 4.7e-03.
